kpis.label: Qualified Opportunities
kpis.tooltip: Commercially qualified opportunities in the authorized inventory.

kpis.label: New Opportunities This Period
kpis.tooltip: New since the prior comparable research period. Shown only when Weekly Change history exists.

kpis.label: Competitive Opportunities
kpis.tooltip: Opportunities visible in Competitive Market Intelligence (may also appear in Hotel scope).

kpis.label: Actionable Opportunities
kpis.tooltip: Opportunities with Build Account, Pursue, or Qualify sales actions — not Monitor-only rows.

kpis.label: Upcoming Demand
kpis.tooltip: Opportunities with evidenced future event dates (ISO event start).

kpis.label: Need Period Alignment
kpis.tooltip: Opportunities aligned to hotel-provided need periods. Requires hotel need-date input.

hoursSaved.label: Estimated Research Hours Saved
hoursSaved.note: Net of an estimated 20% residual hotel review/verification. Ordinary pursuit work is excluded.
